title: Colton Hood out to 'prove Giants right' after falling to second round of 2026 NFL Draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colton Hood out to 'prove Giants right' after falling to second round of 2026 NFL Draft
sources.description: Colton Hood was viewed as one of the risers in the 2026 NFL Draft, so he was definitely a bit disappointed to see himself fall to the second round.
